name: Fanned pages
rationale: Four angled pages fan from a spine point. Reading and depth without a literal open book. Owner pick from ChatGPT exploration grid #5.

name: Scholar bars
tagline: Three vertical strokes — the refined shipped mark
rationale: Descended from the PWA placeholder: three columns suggest text, a bookshelf, and the rhythm of study. Proportions tuned for legibility at 32px and maskable safe zone.

name: Open folio
rationale: An open book from above — aligns with Warm Scholar's serif headings and the 'well-made tool' promise from study/22. The spine uses accent-deep for depth.

name: SL monogram
tagline: Compact serif initials for header lockups
rationale: S and L in a square mark that pairs with the Source Serif wordmark. Best when the name appears beside the icon; less legible alone at favicon size.
basis: Warm Scholar type pairing (Source Serif 4 + DM Sans)

name: Language orbit
rationale: Concentric arcs echo the Words atlas orbit motif. Reads as motion and depth without game-like energy — calm, evidence-driven.
basis: Vocabulary orbit UI + study/22 G1 (colour carries meaning)

name: Text stack
rationale: Descending horizontal rules mimic a paragraph block — text-heavy product, no mascot. Strong at large sizes; test at 32px before shipping.
